Reward.description: "item": an in-game reward, delivered to the game account linked on twitch.tv/drops/campaigns. "badge" and "emote": Twitch-side rewards that need no linked account.

name.description: The game as Twitch shows it, or its URL slug (twitch.tv/directory/category/<slug>). Case-insensitive.

rewards.description: Reward types for this game. Omitted: the goal's `rewards`.

Game.description: A game to mine. Earlier entries go first.

note.description: Free text about this goal, for the people and agents reading the file.

anyOf.description: Every game with an active drop campaign.

games.description: The games to mine: "all", or a list in priority order.

A channel's login, as in twitch.tv/<login>. Case-insensitive.

exclude.description: What to leave out of this goal.

rewards.description: Reward types for games without their own `rewards`.

linkedOnly.description: Mine in-game items only for games whose account is linked on twitch.tv/drops/campaigns. Set false to collect items now and link the game later. Badges and emotes ignore this.

order.description: How to rank campaigns of the same game, or all of them with games "all": "ending-soonest" by end time, "least-slack" by the least time to spare (time left minus minutes still needed), so fewer drops expire unfinished. With "least-slack", a drop that can no longer finish goes last, and the campaign being watched keeps its place until another has 30 minutes less to spare.

claimBonus.description: Claim the bonus chest that appears about every 15 minutes of watching.

DropsGoal.description: Mine drop campaigns. Active while one of its games has a drop to earn on a live channel.

note.description: Free text about this goal, for the people and agents reading the file.

channels.description: Channels to watch for points, highest priority first. The first live one wins.

additionalItems.description: A channel's login, as in twitch.tv/<login>. Case-insensitive.

watchStreaks.description: Keep watch streaks: join a points channel early in each broadcast.

follow.description: Follow a raid to the raided channel to collect the raid bonus.

stayMinutes.description: Minutes to stay on the raided channel before returning to the priorities. Whether the bonus needs any stay is not yet verified.

raids.description: What to do when a channel of this goal raids another channel.

PointsGoal.description: Collect channel points. Active while one of its channels is live.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, for editor and agent autocomplete.

version.description: The config format version. A future format bumps it, and the miner migrates old files.

priorities.description: What to do, highest priority first. The miner works on the first goal that has something to do right now and re-checks whenever a stream goes live or offline, a drop completes, or this file changes. Default: drops for every linked game, plus badges and emotes.

items.description: The game as Twitch shows it, or its URL slug (twitch.tv/directory/category/<slug>). Case-insensitive.
A channel's login, as in twitch.tv/<login>. Case-insensitive.

exclude.description: Never mined or watched, in every goal.

max.description: Streams watched at once. With 2, the next active goal runs beside the first. Twitch credits drops on one stream and points on two; a second stream may slow drop progress (not yet measured), so 1 is the safe default.

MinerConfig.description: Configuration for miner, a headless Twitch drops and channel-points miner. Every field is optional. Check a change with `miner config validate`.
